title: EC2 image templates (templates/ec2/templates.yaml)
description: The EC2 image templates that the platform team provides. An instance in values.yaml must name one of them.

propertyNames.x-error-message: template names must be lowercase letters, digits and hyphens

ami_name_pattern.description: Name pattern of the AMI. The most recent match is used.

user_data_file.description: User data file next to templates.yaml (templatefile syntax). Receives http_port, paths and page_html.
user_data_file.x-error-message: must be a file name next to templates.yaml, without a directory

root_volume_size.description: Root volume size in GiB. Default 8.
